_doc: vehicle id -> nation code of the flag on its icon (nation of origin; an export variant: the nation it was exported to). Codes: US, FR, DE, RU, UA, IT, GB, KR, SU, CN, SE, JP (flags.py draws these). "guess": true marks an assignment made without marking evidence (Elite Expansion 2 pack-wide pass, 2026-10-23); the owner may reassign.
